name: Ugro Capital Limited

verdict_notes: margin fell QoQ and is not up YoY
revenue fell more than 5% QoQ (seasonally adjusted)

missing.reason: not in results store (not filed, not fetched, or filer is half-yearly)

annual_report.business: UGRO Capital Limited is a middle-layer NBFC focused on addressing India's MSME credit gap through a pan-India network of 317 Emerging Market branches and embedded merchant finance via digital platforms, offering secured loan against property and machinery finance to small businesses.

capacity_or_capex.item: Acquisition of Profectus Capital Private Limited (100% shares)
Acquisition of Datasigns Technologies Private Limited (MyShubhLife platform)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Progressive shift in portfolio mix towards higher-yielding core segments (Emerging Market secured lending and Embedded Merchant finance) while reducing exposure to intermediated lower yield portfolios
Structured cost rationalisation programme linked to exit from non-core verticals to enhance operating efficiency
Intermediated portfolio being run down in orderly manner while share of recurring annuity-led income is increasing
Transition expected to strengthen capital adequacy and enable growth supported through internal accruals
guidance_or_targets.value: Stronger CAR and internal accrual funded growth

key_risks: Impairment of loans including Expected Credit Loss (ECL) involving significant management judgement in grouping loan portfolio, estimation of losses for groups with minimal past defaults, and macroeconomic forecasts
Interest rate risk from variable rate borrowings (48.27% of total borrowings at 9.97% weighted average cost)
Liquidity risk managed through LCR framework (maintained above 100% regulatory minimum)
Foreign currency borrowing exposure hedged through currency swaps and forward contracts
Concentration risk in MSME lending across Tier 2/3/4 geographies
Execution risk in strategic realignment from scale to profitability focus
Integration risk from recent acquisitions (Profectus Capital and MyShubhLife)

latest_guidance.statement: Guided annual growth of 20-30% for Emerging Market LAP and 35-40% for GROx
Target ROA of 3% to 3.5% by FY29 on pro forma basis
Quarterly operating cost guidance of INR490 crores for FY27
Guided prime intermediated book rundown of 15-20% per year
Expect every quarter to be better than previous quarter on profit
